sentences.text: Petugas dinas kesehatan menyegel lemari berisi obat palsu di apotek seberang.
sentences.en: Health officials sealed a cabinet of fake medicine at the pharmacy across the street.
sentences.ko: 보건 당국이 맞은편 약국의 가짜 약 진열장을 봉인했어요.

sentences.text: Agus mendaftarkan diri sebagai relawan penanaman bakau di muara.
sentences.en: Agus signed himself up as a volunteer for mangrove planting at the estuary.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 강어귀 맹그로브 심기 자원봉사자로 신청했어요.

sentences.text: Wati mendaftarkan apoteknya ke program obat murah pemerintah.
sentences.en: Wati registered her pharmacy in the government's affordable medicine program.
sentences.ko: 와티는 약국을 정부 저가 약 사업에 등록했어요.

sentences.text: Bibit padi unggul dari dinas pertanian tumbuh subur di sawah keluarga Agus.
sentences.en: The high-quality rice seedlings from the agriculture office grow well in Agus's family's paddy.
sentences.ko: 농업 사무소에서 받은 우량 볍씨가 아구스네 논에서 잘 자라요.

sentences.text: Apotek Wati unggul dalam pelayanan karena buka dua puluh empat jam.
sentences.en: Wati's pharmacy excels in service because it's open twenty-four hours.
sentences.ko: 와티의 약국은 이십사 시간 문을 열어서 서비스가 뛰어나요.

sentences.text: Waktu kecil, Agus pernah membolos sekolah untuk memancing di sungai.
sentences.en: As a child, Agus once skipped school to go fishing in the river.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 어릴 때 학교를 빼먹고 강에 낚시하러 간 적이 있어요.

sentences.text: Seorang siswa membolos dan duduk lama di apotek sambil main ponsel.
sentences.en: A student skipped school and sat in the pharmacy for a long time playing on his phone.
sentences.ko: 한 학생이 학교를 빼먹고 약국에 오래 앉아 휴대폰을 했어요.

sentences.text: Bunga teratai di rawa dekat sungai mekar setiap pagi.
sentences.en: The lotus flowers in the swamp near the river bloom every morning.
sentences.ko: 강 근처 늪의 연꽃이 아침마다 피어나요.

sentences.text: Anggrek di jendela apotek mekar tepat saat Wati berulang tahun.
sentences.en: The orchid on the pharmacy window bloomed right on Wati's birthday.
sentences.ko: 약국 창가의 난초가 마침 와티 생일에 꽃을 피웠어요.
